        '--pilot-spec','configs/smoke_e2e_pilot.json','--engineering-smoke','t4_one_update_engineering_v1',
        '--timeout-seconds',str(timeout_seconds),'--gate-timeout-seconds',str(GATE_SECONDS)]

        'exact_cache_sources':sources,

    commands.add_parser('qualification')

    normal.add_argument('--cache31-result-json',required=True)
